patch_description:
The fixed training configuration uses Adam with learning_rate=0.03, 100 epochs, 30 mini-batch steps per epoch, batch_size=15, l=3 data re-uploading, and p=2 ansatz repetitions per upload. The current ansatz is parameter-efficient but underfits: train accuracy is only about 0.43, suggesting that the circuit lacks strong nonlinear line features early in optimization.

This proposal keeps the same inputs, outputs, data construction, optimizer, feature map, l, p, and measurements, but changes the ansatz block. The new block adds trainable RX sign decoders before entanglement, fixed CNOT line aggregators from endpoints to legal midpoint cells, and CRX/CRY controlled rotations. The CNOTs provide immediate non-parametric pair-product features instead of waiting for near-zero controlled-rotation parameters to grow under Adam. CRX is aligned with the RX feature encoding and should improve player-sign sensitivity, while CRY mixers preserve the successful prior line-aggregation motif. Parameters remain orbit-shared for tic-tac-toe symmetry and efficiency, with 90 total parameters across all uploads/repeats.
